judge.rationale: The candidate's implementation of `accumulateUsage` is functionally identical to the reference and properly handles all accumulation and partial/missing usage cases without bugs. However, against the acceptance criterion that 'the type of what the hook receives makes the answer unambiguous', the candidate only added a JSDoc comment while keeping the parameter named `usage` (and local variable `lastUsage`), whereas the reference renamed the parameter and variable to `totalUsage` across the code and docs. Additionally, in `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, the candidate placed the new behavior bullets under the 'Measured semantics — out of scope' section instead of moving the specification to the main in-scope section as the reference did. Finally, the candidate extracted test helpers into a new `orchestratorTestHelpers.ts` file and created a separate `chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts` file rather than adding tests directly to `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`.
